summary: Tested the 'Kurangi stok' (Keluar/rusak) feature end to end. Backend: the new `rusak` field on /api/data works. PUT persists it, GET returns it, docs without rusak return [], wrong type gives 422, more than 5000 items gives 413, and PUT /api/profile keeps rusak. 30/30 backend tests pass (9 new). Frontend at 375x667, all flows pass: the card title reads 'Stok Persediaan'. Adding stock with a new jenis creates a Masuk row and the picker auto-selects the new jenis. Kurangi validation shows toasts for missing jenis, missing jumlah and jumlah above sisa (7). The red Kurangi button (rgb 196,47,92) adds a rusak row with FIFO HPP and switches to the Keluar/rusak tab. Tab counts and filtering are correct. The rekap formula is correct: 10 masuk - 3 terjual - 4 rusak = 3, and nilai rusak = Rp 8.000 (2 left at 1000 + 2 at 3000 = avg 2000 x 4). The Masuk 'Sekarang' column goes down oldest-first (old row 0, new row 3). Deleting a rusak entry returns the stock (sisa back to 10). Data persists after reload. Dashboard Stok sekarang (3) and Pesanan baru picker ('Aglo · sisa 3') include rusak. No deprecated Expo packages were found in the files reviewed.

issues: Trash buttons in the rusak table (rusak-hapus-{id}) measure 36x17px, below the 44x44 touch target. The trash buttons in the Masuk table are the same size and have no testID. Reference: app/stok-barang.tsx:310, 359, 449
Deleting a rusak or Masuk row happens right away with no confirmation dialog.

'Kurangi stok barang' is not directly under '+ Tambah stok barang'. A divider, a 'Barang rusak / mati' subtitle and the Keterangan field sit between them (about 176px gap). This works, but the user asked for the button directly below.

action_items: Optional: make the trash Pressables in both stok tables at least 44x44 (use hitSlop or padding) and add a testID (e.g. belanja-hapus-{id}) to the Masuk row delete button.

Optional: when a Masuk (belanja) row is deleted and its stock is already used by pesanan or rusak, either block the delete or warn the user, because Stok sekarang can go negative (app/stok-barang.tsx:113).
critical_code_review_comments: hapus() for belanja does not check whether pesanan or rusak already use that row's stock, so sisaStok / rekap-sisa can go negative.
The rusak search does `r.jenis + ' ' + r.ket`. If ket is missing in legacy or imported data, the string becomes 'undefined'. Use `r.ket || ''`.
Rusak.harga is captured at record time (FIFO). Later edits or deletes of belanja rows do not recompute it. This is acceptable but worth knowing.
seed_data_creation: Mongo users and sessions: test-rusak-ui (token test_rusak_ui_token), test-rusak-api (test_rusak_api_token), test-rusak-legacy (test_rusak_legacy_token, app_data without rusak field). The UI user has belanja Aglo 5@1000 (2025-01-01) and 5@3000 (2025-02-01), 1 pesanan of 3 Aglo, a Masuk row TEST_Monstera 4@2000, and 1 rusak TEST_Monstera x1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth: set localStorage 'lpm_session_token' to a session token, then reload. Picker options have testID picker-item-{value}; the new-jenis option is picker-item-__BARU__. Toasts are found via document.body.innerText. Don't press reset-demo.
